summary.headline: Planetary Lots and Palchus Index
summary.text: Continuation of the chapter index for Apomasar’s astrological mysteries, covering Venus, Mercury, Moon, planetary lots, Apomasar’s lots of the twelve places, unassigned lots, buying slaves, and foreign travel. The page then begins the chapter index of Palchus’s apotelesmatic book, with entries on the twelve signs, four seasons, and seasonal turnings.
